trap.label: ordem das palavras
trap.wrong: Tired I was as, I went.
trap.right: Tired as I was, I went.
trap.why: Em português “cansado como estava” soa literal; em inglês adjetivo + as + sujeito + verbo para concessão.

opts: As tired I am, I went.
Tired I am as, I went.
Tired as I am, I went.

mcq.q: Try as I might, I can’t.
Same meaning as “Although I was tired”:

fix.wrong: As tired I was, I went.
fix.right: Tired as I was, I went.

fix.wrong: Try as I might it, I can’t.
fix.right: Try as I might, I can’t.

fix.wrong: Notwithstanding that it rained a lot, we went.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com “as”: “Although I was tired, I went.”
rewrite.answer: Tired as I was, I went.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com notwithstanding: “Despite the delay, we left.”
Reescreva no presente: “Try as I might, I could not.”
rewrite.answer: Try as I might, I cannot.
